tools.name: resource_flow_start
tools.description: Create a server-owned Flow from a goal-oriented task.

tools.name: resource_flow_status
tools.description: Read the recoverable authoritative Flow control-plane snapshot without confirmation secrets.

tools.name: resource_search
tools.description: Search across multiple platforms in parallel, then persist an immutable ResultSet that is not yet a Presentation; requests may replace or extend a base ResultSet.

tools.name: resource_presentation_save
tools.description: Persist the exact ordered subset actually displayed from one ResultSet, including an intentionally empty Presentation.

tools.name: resource_selection_save
tools.description: Save explicit user choices by positions from the current authoritative Presentation.

tools.name: resource_download_prepare
tools.description: Create an expiring Plan from the current Selection and inspected Representation, binding only the exact strategy and Provider the user is asked to confirm.

tools.name: resource_download_start
tools.description: Consume a confirmed Plan after revalidating the current Selection, Representation, and exact Provider route, then create a Job.

tools.name: resource_job_status
tools.description: Read Job progress, per-resource execution routes, outcomes, assets, and failures.

tools.name: resource_job_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation of a queued or running Job.

tools.name: resource_archive
tools.description: Archive a ready Asset from a succeeded Job without accepting a local path.

tools.name: resource_library_search
tools.description: Search archived Assets through bounded metadata filters and an opaque cursor.

tools.name: resource_browse_creator
tools.description: Browse a creator's full content list from social-media platforms that expose a supported creator-search adapter.

tools.name: resource_inspect
tools.description: Inspect one existing Flow resource through a server-selected bounded inspection profile without accepting a URL or local path.
